title: Garages and carports merit assessment criteria
text: Garages and/or carports are set back to: (i) contribute positively to the streetscape and appearance of dwellings; (ii) maintain clear sightlines along the street, not obstruct views of dwellings from the street and vice versa; and (iii) ensure vehicle parking on a driveway only occurs where space permits and does not impede on any existing or planned adjoining pedestrian, cycle, or dual-use path.
